newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai to brief media on reports of merger delay.
newsitem.headline: Bandai to brief media on reports of merger delay.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said it would hold a news conference later on Monday on newspaper reports that it is planning to postpone the signing of its merger agreement with Sega Enterprises Ltd.
A company spokeswoman declined to give any more details about the news conference.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday that Bandai's board had voted to delay the signing, originally scheduled to be completed by the end of May, to July.

Bandai, whose business has recently been buoyed by the huge popularity of its "Tamagotchi" electronic pet toy, has decided on the move as some of its middle-ranking managers remain strongly opposed to the merger, the newspaper said.
The two companies said earlier that they planned to merge on October 1.
